description: Historical shares-outstanding and cash series from SEC XBRL filings, with offering and material-cash-event overlays that line an issuance or a raise up against the share count and cash balance around it: share-count growth over time and the cash trajectory between financings. The historical share counts are as filed: each point is on the split basis in force when it was reported and is not rebased to today, so a reverse split shows as a step and points either side of one are not directly comparable (a growth rate computed across a split boundary from these raw points is not meaningful). A gap in the series means no filing supplied that period, not that the share count was unchanged. Returns HTTP 200 for unavailable data; the `available` and `reason` fields say why. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. A null, absent or withheld value means the figure was not measured; it does not mean "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a measured zero, so availability is carried by the availability, withheld and reason fields, not by the value. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted rather than published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_dilution_history
title: Get Shares-Outstanding and Cash History
